name: Farfetch’d
description: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a slash of claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user attacks with its head. It may make the foe flinch. To find Pokémon, hit trees.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.description: The user counters the foe by mimicking the move last used by the foe.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.description: The user covers the foe with a mass of down that sharply lowers the Attack stat.

moves.name: Covet
moves.description: The user endearingly approaches the foe, then steals the item the foe is holding.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
